obligations.source_text: Create a photorealistic wide editorial disaster photograph inside an orbital emergency airlock. One unmistakably adult woman, guided only by the reference's visible long center-parted dark wavy hair, dark brown eyes, softly arched brows, and broadly comparable face proportions, is captured in a single continuous moment halfway across a circular docking threshold into a reentry capsule. Her leading hand, torso, and boot are inside the capsule while her trailing boot has just lifted over the metal sill, establishing one readable direction. Behind her, the damaged habitat corridor is decompressing; loose insulation and fractured panels stream backward as segmented pressure-door blades close and the flexible docking tunnel tears away along the exact return path. Ahead, Earth fills the forward window and the first orange reentry-plasma streaks have already begun across the capsule exterior. Keep her face readable, the full threshold visible, and the causal approach-crossing-consequence chain dominant.

bindings.subject_phrase: one identifiable subject object or process remains continuous from approach through crossing into the downstream state, realized as the single adult woman whose torso and two boots occupy one uninterrupted crossing pose
bindings.threshold_phrase: a concrete bridge hatch airlock edge line or boundary owns the one-way transition: the circular metal docking collar and its closing segmented pressure-door blades form the physical threshold
bindings.crossing_phrase: the subject intersects or has just cleared that threshold along one readable direction of travel, with her leading hand torso and boot inside the capsule and her trailing boot lifting over the sill
bindings.lost_path_phrase: the route behind visibly closes collapses floods burns severs or is consumed so return is physically unavailable, as the pressure-door blades close and the flexible docking tunnel tears away along that same path
bindings.consequence_phrase: a concrete new condition or irreversible downstream process has already begun beyond the threshold, visible as Earth filling the capsule window and first orange reentry plasma streaking across its exterior
